question: Who among the following was awarded the Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime achievement in Sports and Games 2021 in chess?
solution:
The correct answer is Abhijeet Kunte

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Abhijeet Kunte was awarded Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement for chess on 13 November 2021 by The President of India.

__
 
• He received this award from the President of India at a specially organized function at the Darbar Hall of Rashtrapati Bhavan​
 
• The award is given to honor the sportsperson who has performed well in their sportsmanship period and continues contributing to promoting the sport after his/her retirement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Abhijeet kunte**

__
 
• Abhijeet kunte is an Indian chess player
 
• He has been littled as** Grandmaster by FIDE.**
 
• He has been The Chairman of the Selection Committee and Chief Coach All India Chess Federation
 
• He is Chief Manger at Indian Oil Corporation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• It is given to a **sportsperson for outstanding performance** **in the field of sports by a sportsperson over a period of the previous four years.**
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Awards**
 
 
• This Award is given to that **sportsperson who has been performing good over the period of the previous four years and showing qualities of leadership, sportsmanship and a sense of discipline.**
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Award**
 
 
• This Award is given **to the coaches for doing outstanding and meritorious work on a consistent basis and enabling sportspersons to excel in International events.**
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar **
 
 
• This Award is given to **corporate entities** both in the private and public sector, sports control boards, NGOs including sports bodies at the state and National level **who have played a visible role in the area of sports promotion and development. **
 
 
 
• **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy**
 
 
• Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy is given to a **university for Overall top-performing in inter-university tournaments**
